form.desc:
Store Preview Studio is the professional listing designer and pre-flight audit studio for iOS and Android developers, indie creators, and digital agencies.

Craft high-converting App Store Connect and Google Play Console product listings side-by-side with instantaneous real-time sync, automated store limit validation, and Retina-grade mockup generation — offline in your browser.

CORE CAPABILITIES:
• Dual-Store Live Viewports: Simultaneously visualize how your app listing looks on both iOS and Android before publishing.
• Pre-Flight Compliance Audit: Automated real-time checking of title lengths, character limits, and store dimension requirements.
• App Icon Inspector: Audit master 1024x1024 icons, test transparency compliance against Apple opaque icon guidelines, and preview adaptive squircle shapes.
• Ultra HD 3x Multi-Format Export: Download pristine 3x Retina PNG device mockups, comprehensive client-side ZIP bundles, and developer Markdown specifications in 1 click.
• Client-Side Privacy: Operates completely offline with zero tracking, zero server dependencies, and zero monthly subscriptions.

PRICING & LICENSING:
Pay once on Gumroad, own forever. No subscriptions, no cloud vendor lock-in.
